data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(Infrastructure task — each DD owned by task-1..task-5; this Makefile binds them so operator can run full per-phase audit via 'make audit-phase PHASE=N'.)

Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/Makefile.audit defining target audit-phase requiring PHASE=<n>. Invokes audits in dep order: dd4 (gate) → dd1 (baseline) → dd2 (orphan diff) → dd3 (mutation caps) → dd5 (bundler). Any non-zero short-circuits. .PHONY + help target.

## Test Approach
Given audit script stubs all exit 0 in order; When make -f Makefile.audit audit-phase PHASE=2 runs; Then all 5 execute in order dd4→dd1→dd2→dd3→dd5 (verified via call-order stub) + exit 0. Given dd2 stub exits 4; Then dd3+dd5 NOT invoked + target exits non-zero.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] audit-phase invokes audits in dd4→dd1→dd2→dd3→dd5 order
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_makefile_audit.sh::test_invocation_order
- [ ] Non-zero from earlier audit short-circuits later audits
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_makefile_audit.sh::test_short_circuit_on_failure
- [ ] Missing PHASE variable produces clear usage error
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_makefile_audit.sh::test_missing_phase_var

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/Makefile.audit — Create
- tests/unit/scripts/test_makefile_audit.sh — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
